rss.title: Satisfying 3D Animation: Everything Shatters… Then Rewinds ✨

Satisfying 3D animation for relaxing and stress relief ✨ Christmas ornaments, crystal geodes, disco balls, gumball globes, watermelons, snow globes, chocolate eggs and piñatas fall onto glowing neon grids, shatter into hundreds of pieces… then everything rewinds and rebuilds itself 🔁

Every scene has its own floor: honeycomb, square, diamond, triangle and round holes. Put it on, relax, and watch it all come back together.

Which one was the most satisfying? Tell me the timestamp in the comments 👇
